x-k-k10-01.title: Hal murti, laba dareen
x-k-k10-01.goal: Ka gaar macnaha mugdiga ah ee wadaagga ah ee 손이 크다 saddex weedhood, go'aami meesha ay ka muujinayso cabasho, oo kuna sharax caddayn la soo xigtay sababta dareenku u kala duwan yahay.
x-k-k10-01.material:
Saddex qof ayaa ka hadlaya qof. Isla odhaahda 손이 크다 mar kasta way ka muuqataa (halkan lama macneeyo).
(가) 엄마는 손이 커서 김장할 때마다 이웃 몫까지 넉넉하게 담그세요.
(나) 동생은 손이 커서 월급날이면 친구들에게 밥을 사다가 월말에는 늘 빠듯해요.
(다) 새 요리사는 손이 커서 찌개를 끓이면 늘 열 명 분이 나와서 매번 반이 남아요.
x-k-k10-01.thinking.0: Ka gaarista macnaha murtida iyadoo laga eegayo dhowr xaaladood
x-k-k10-01.thinking.1: Kala saarista macnaha asaasiga ah iyo dareenka dheeraadka ah
x-k-k10-01.prereq.0: Wuu akhriyi karaa weedhaha Kuuriyaanka ee leh -아서/-어서 iyo -(으)ㄹ 때마다
x-k-k10-01.prereq.1: Wuu ogyahay in Kuuriyaanku leeyahay odhaahyo go'an oo macnahoodu aanu ahayn isu geynta erayadooda
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.prompt: Macnaha asaasiga ah ee 손이 크다 ee saddexda weedhood ku habboon waa kee?
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dabool murtida oo weydii waxa ay saddexda xaaladood (김장, 월급날, 찌개) wadaagaan.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Doorasho kasta ku tijaabi saddexda weedhood oo dhan, ma aha kaliya tan ugu fudud ee dhawaaqeeda wanaagsan.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.a: Qofku wuxuu leeyahay gacmo jirka ahaan waaweyn oo rashiinka u faa'iido leh.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.a: Erayada oo si toos ah loo qaaday. Hubi (나): mushahar iyo saaxiibbo la marti qaadayaa kuma xirna cabbirka gacanta.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.b: Qofku waa kariye xirfad leh oo cunto macaan sameeya xaalad kasta.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.b: Isku xirid (가) iyo (다). Hubi (나): kalkaalin kuma jirto, sidaa darteed macnuhu waa inuu ka ballaaran yahay karinta.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.c: Qofku wuxuu lacag ku kharash gareeyaa isagoo aan ka fikirin berrito.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.c: Wuxuu ku habboon yahay (나) oo keliya. Hubi (가) iyo (다): waxay ku saabsan yihiin cadadka cuntada, ma aha kharash dayacan.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.d: Qofku wuxuu cunto, lacag ama hadiyado ku maareeyaa cabbir badan oo deeqsinimo leh.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.d: Dhisidda macne ka badbaada saddexda xaaladood oo dhan, ma aha kii ugu horreeyay oo keliya.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.explain: Saddexdaba, 손이 크다 wuxuu qeexayaa qof isticmaala, bixiya ama sameeya waxyaabo xaddi badan. Karinta iyo lacagtu waa dhinacyo keliya.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.prompt: Weedhaha kuwee ayuu hadluhu 손이 크다 u arkaa ugu yaraan dhibaato yar? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.0: Weedh kasta, weydii sida hadluhu u dhawaaqayo: ma farxad, dhexdhexaad, mise werwer?
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kadibna raadi erayada weedhda ku jira ee kuu keenaya dareenkaas.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.a: Akhrinta 넉넉하게 / 이웃 몫까지 sida faahfaahin diiran, ma aha cabasho. Weedhdu ma laha natiijo xun.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.b: Ogaanshaha qaybta natiijada 빠듯해요 (lacagtu way yar tahay) ayaa isla caadadii u beddelaya werwer.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.c: Ogaanshaha 매번 반이 남아요 (mar kasta kala bar ayaa lumaya) sida natiijada xun.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.explain: Macnaha asaasiga ah ee murtidu waa dhexdhexaad. Dareenku wuxuu ka yimaadaa qaybta natiijada: 빠듯해요 iyo 반이 남아요 waxay tilmaamaan dhibaato, halka 넉넉하게 ee (가) ay saaxiibtinimo tahay.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.prompt: Ingiriis ama Kuuriyaan ku sharax sababta isla murtidu ugu dareemayso diirimaad (가) laakiin werwer (나). Ka soo xigo ugu yaraan hal weer oo Kuuriyaan ah oo ka mid ah weedhaha sida caddayn.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ka soo xigo qaybta natiijada weedh kasta.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.1: Sheeg waxa isku mid ah (murtida) iyo waxa kala duwan (natiijada).
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegay waxa isku mid ah iyo waxa isbeddelaya?
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tilmaamay erayada saxda ah ee dareenka sida?
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma heli karaa fasalkayga caddayntayda qoraalka dhexdiisa?
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.0: (가) gudaheeda qaybta 이웃 몫까지 넉넉하게 waxay muujinaysaa wadaagid, sidaa darteed deeqsinimo waa la ammaanayaa. (나) gudaheeda isla caadadu waxay keenaysaa 월말에는 늘 빠듯해요, sidaa darteed natiijadu waa dhibaato lacageed. Murtidu waa isku mid; qaybta natiijadu waxay beddelaysaa dareenka.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.1: 손이 크다 wuxuu oranayaa oo keliya inuu qofku waxyaabo ku isticmaalo xaddi badan. (가) taasi dariiqa way caawisaa, laakiin (나) 빠듯해요 wuxuu muujinayaa inay walaalka lacag ku kacayso, sidaa darteed hadluhu wuu werwersan yahay.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.2: (가) 넉넉하게 담그세요 waa hadiyad dariiqa loo sameeyay sidaa darteed way diirran tahay; (나) 월말에는 늘 빠듯해요 waa dhibaato lacageed sidaa darteed way werwersan tahay.

x-k-k10-02.title: Akhrinta ciwaan wargeys iyo tirooyinkiisa
x-k-k10-02.goal: Ka hel weedhda maqaal war oo gaaban ee sheeganaysa wax ka badan inta caddayntu taageerto, kuna dib u qor ciwaanka si uu ula mid noqdo xogta oo uu u xusuusiyo xadidaadda sahanka.
x-k-k10-02.material:
Ciwaan: 서울 시민 다수, 대중교통 요금 인상 찬성
(Marka hore akhri ciwaanka, kadibna afarta weedh ee maqaalka, oo ah 1 ilaa 4.)
x-k-k10-02.thinking.0: Hubinta sheegasho iyadoo lala barbardhigayo tirooyinka
x-k-k10-02.thinking.2: Dib u qorista ciwaan si sax ah
x-k-k10-02.prereq.0: Wuu akhriyi karaa boqolleyda iyo tirooyinka wararka Kuuriyaanka
x-k-k10-02.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan erayada 찬성, 반대, 응답자
x-k-k10-02.prereq.2: Wuu yaqaan 다수 (badan / inta badan) iyo 과반 (nus ka badan)
x-k-k10-02.s.s1.prompt: Hal weedh ayaa sheegaysa wax ka badan inta weedhaha ka horreeya taageeraan. Kee?
x-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.0: Barbardhig boqolleyda weedhda labaad iyo gabagabada ka soo baxday tan ugu dambaysa.
x-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Weydii dhab ahaantii yaa ahaa 1,000-kii qof ka hor intaadan go'aamin waxa ay matali karaan.
x-k-k10-02.s.s1.explain: Khadka 4 waa kan xad-dhaafka ah. 다수 wuxuu u egyahay 'inta badan', laakiin 48% waa ka yar nus iyo 41% way ka soo horjeedeen: 찬성 waa kooxda ugu weyn (tiro ugu badan), ma aha aqlabiyad. Khadka 3 sidoo kale wuxuu muujinayaa in kaliya dadka laga helay xarumaha tareenka dhulka hoostiisa ee saacadda dadku degdegsan yihiin ay jawaabeen, sidaa darteed ma matali karaan dhammaan muwaadiniinta Seoul.
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.prompt: Ku dib u qor ciwaanka Kuuriyaan si uu ula mid noqdo tirooyinka, oo ku dar hal weedh (Kuuriyaan ama Ingiriis) oo magacaabaysa xad ka mid ah sahankan.
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isticmaal tirooyinka dhabta ah ee khadka 2 halkii aad ka isticmaali lahayd eray aan caddayn.
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.1: Eeg khadka 3 si aad u hesho xadka.
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma ciwaankaygu wuxuu sheegayaa oo keliya waxa 48% iyo 41% oggol yihiin?
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma xadka aan magacaabay wuxuu ku saabsan yahay yaa la weydiiyay, ma aha mawduucaa?
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma akhristaha ciwaankayga lagu marin habaabin karaa 'dhammaan muwaadiniinta'?

x-k-k10-03.title: Ma maktabaddu waxay keentaa darajooyinka?
x-k-k10-03.goal: Go'aami macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee caawin lahaa tijaabinta in isticmaalka maktabaddu keeno darajooyin sare, ogow akhris sababta rogan, oo qor hal su'aal oo cilmi-baaraha loo weydiinayo.
x-k-k10-03.material: Soo koobid war: 한 연구에서 한 달에 도서관을 8번 이상 이용한 학생의 평균 성적이 2번 미만 이용한 학생보다 높았다. 연구자는 "도서관 이용이 성적을 올린다"고 말했다.
x-k-k10-03.prereq.0: Wuu akhriyi karaa soo koobid war oo Kuuriyaan ah oo gaaban
x-k-k10-03.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan erayada 성적, 이용, 평균
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.prompt: Xaqiiqooyinka dheeraadka ah ee kuwee ayaa kaa caawin lahaa inaad go'aamiso in isticmaalka maktabaddu KEENO darajooyin sare? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Doorasho kasta weydii: jawaabtu ma beddeli lahayd sida ay u macquul tahay in maktabaddu tahay sababta?
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Weydii waxa kale oo kala duwanaan kara isticmaalayaasha maktabadda badan iyo kuwa yar.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.a: Haddii darajooyinka isla ardayda la qiyaasay ka hor iyo ka dib markay bilaabeen inay maktabadda si joogto ah u isticmaalaan
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.a: Raadinta isbeddel waqti ah oo isla dadka ku yimid, taas oo barbardhig keliya aanu muujin karin.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.b: Noocyada buugaagta ardaydu inta badan amaahdeen
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.b: Faahfaahin xiiso leh oo isticmaalka ku saabsan, laakiin kuma tilmaamayso in isticmaalku mise wax kale ay keenaan darajooyinka.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.c: Haddii ardayda maktabadda badan isticmaasha mar horeba wax badan wax ka bartaan ama ay si ka badan u dhiirrigeliyaan
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.c: Raadinta arrin saddexaad oo sharrixi karta isticmaalka maktabadda iyo darajooyinka labadaba.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.d: Celceliska darajada dhammaan ardayda dalka waa maxay
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.d: Celcelis qaran wuxuu muujiyaa in ardaydan caadi yihiin, ma aha waxa sababa farqigooda.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.e: Haddii darajooyinku ka yimaadeen diiwaannada dugsiga ama warbixinnada ardayda laftooda
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.e: Hubinta sida lagu kalsoonaan karo tirooyinka darajooyinka; tani waxay caawisaa sheegasho oo dhan, in kasta oo aanay ku saabsanayn sababta lafteeda.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.explain: Si loo tijaabiyo sababta waxaad u baahan tahay xog ka hor/ka dib oo ku saabsan isla ardayda (a) iyo hubin arrimo kale sida waqtiga waxbarashada ama dhiirrigelinta (c). Noocyada buugaagta iyo celcelis qaran sababta kuma saabsana.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.acc.0: Hubinta sida darajooyinka loo qiyaasay (e) waa macquul sababtoo ah waxay tijaabisaa kalsoonida xogta, in kasta oo aanay si toos ah u saabsanayn sababta.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.prompt: Akhriste ayaa leh: "Waxaa laga yaabaa ardayda darajooyinka sare leh inay jecelyihiin waxbarasho, sidaa darteed maktabadda ayay badan tagaan." Fikraddee ayay tani muujinaysaa?
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Barbardhig waxa daraasaddu leedahay iyo waxa akhristuhu leeyahay: mid kasta, kee ayaa sabab ah kuna kee saameyn?
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi doorashada ku saabsan jihada, ma aha daacadnimo ama muunad qaadasho.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.a: Daraasaddu waa inay ahayd mid aan daacad ahayn.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.a: Si degdeg ah daraasadda loogu eedeeyay; fikradda akhristuhu waxay ku saabsan tahay jihada, ma aha daacadnimo.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.b: Isticmaalka maktabadda iyo darajooyinku hubaal ma xirnaan.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.b: Sixid xad-dhaaf ah: rogidda jihada macnaheedu maaha inaan xiriir jirin.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.c: Sababtu waxay u socon kartaa dhinaca kale: darajooyin sare (ama caadooyin wax-barasho) ayaa laga yaabaa inay keenaan isticmaal maktabad oo badan.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.c: Tixgelinta jihada rogan ee sababta iyo saameynta.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.d: Waxaa la sahamiyay oo keliya ardayda jecel akhriska.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.d: Isku dhafidda werwer muunad qaadasho oo weedhda akhristuhu aanay sheegin.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.explain: Akhristuhu wuxuu soo jeedinayaa sabab rogan. Isla tirooyinkaas labada jihoodba way ku habboon yihiin, taas oo ah sababta sheegashada ah in isticmaalka maktabaddu kor u qaado darajooyinka ay xogta ka sii dhaafayso.
x-k-k10-03.s.s3.prompt: Kuuriyaan ku qor HAL su'aal oo aad cilmi-baaraha weydiin lahayd ka hor intaadan aqbalin "도서관 이용이 성적을 올린다".
x-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Dooro xaqiiqo maqan oo tallaabada 1 ka timid, ama jihada rogan oo tallaabada 2 ka timid.
x-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir waxa aad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato si aad u meesha ka saarto sharraxaad kale.
x-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma su'aashaydu waxay tilmaamaysaa xaqiiqo maqan, ma aha shaki keliya?

x-k-k10-04.title: Akhrinta 'oh, okay…'
x-k-k10-04.topic: Codka iyo macnaha dadban ee sheekada
x-k-k10-04.goal: Dib u eeg akhrintaada jawaabta wada-shaqeeye marka sheekada intii kale la muujiyo, oo sharax weer Kuuriyaan ah kuwee ayaa fikradaada beddelay.
x-k-k10-04.material: Sheeko kooxeed shirkad Kuuriyaan ah gudaheeda. 지민 waa xubinta ugu cusub. 선배 waa wada-shaqeeye sare. Sheekada waxaa lagu muujiyaa saddex tallaabo.
x-k-k10-04.thinking.0: Akhrinta macnaha dadban ee ka dambeeya edeb-darrada
x-k-k10-04.thinking.1: Dib u eegidda xukun iyadoo caddayn cusub la helay
x-k-k10-04.thinking.2: La soo xigashada weero sida caddayn
x-k-k10-04.prereq.0: Wuu akhriyi karaa sheeko Kuuriyaan ah oo aan rasmi ahayn
x-k-k10-04.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan in 괜찮아 iyo 알겠습니다 la odhan karo iyadoo aan si farxad leh loo oggolayn
x-k-k10-04.prereq.2: Wuu yaqaan 막내 (xubinta ugu yar) iyo 어차피 (si kastaba)
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.prompt: Akhri qayb kasta oo sheekada ka mid ah. Mid kasta ka dib, dooro akhrinta ugu macquulsan ee waxa 지민 dareemayso.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.0: Weydii naftaada waxa la yiri iyo waxa keliya oo la dhaleeceeyay.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qayb cusub kasta ka dib, hubi in akhrintaadii hore weli ku habboon tahay.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Hadda kaliya waxaa muuqda wax ka fiirsasho. 네 waxay macnaheedu noqon kartaa 'waan ku maqlay', 아 ee bilowga iyo '…' ee dhammaadka waxay soo jeedinayaan khalkhal.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Way ku farxaysaa inay is-ugu tabarucdo.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Akhrinta 네 sida xiise, iyadoo la iska indho tirayo 아 iyo '…' ee dambe.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Akhrinta diidmo eray macnihiisu yahay haa.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Su'aashay maqashay oo way ka fiirsanaysaa, iyadoo aan si cad is-ugu tabarucin.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ogaanshaha in 네 halkan ay ka jawaabayso 'waan ku maqlay', ma aha 'waan sameyn doonaa'.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.1.after: 알겠습니다 wuxuu aqbalayaa shaqada, halka 제가요? iyo nasashadu ay muujinayaan yaab iyo diidmo. Way hoggaansantay; taasi way ka duwan tahay inay si farxad leh u oggolaato.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Way farxaysaa oo way mahadcelinaysaa sare.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Loo qaadanayo 알겠습니다 rasmi ah diirimaad ahaan.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Way samayn doontaa laakiin kuma farxsana.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Aragtida in '알겠습니다' yahay hoggaansan halka '제가요?' muujinayo yaab.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Si edeb leh ayay u tidhi maya.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka lumida in 알겠습니다 yahay aqbalaad.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ka dib, 지민 wuxuu u qoray saaxiib: "자료 정리? 뭐, 어차피 내가 제일 막내인데 어쩌겠어. 괜찮아."
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ka soo qaad in sare uu ogaaday waxa ay saaxiibkeed u qortay. Tallaabada xigta ee ugu fiican waa maxay?
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 어쩌겠어 macnaheedu waa inay arkin doorasho dhab ah, 막내 ayaa sharraxaysa sababta. 괜찮아 halkan wuxuu u egyahay hab lagu xidho mawduuca, ma aha hadal raaxo ah.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Soo jeedi inaad la wadaagto shaqada ama aad caawiso, oo la socod.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Loo qaadanayo 어쩌겠어 iyo 막내 sida calaamado culeys hal dhinac ah.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Si diirran ugu mahadnaq sheeko kooxeedka oo halkaas ka daa.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Naxariis leh, laakiin waxay ka jawaabaysaa 'way fiican tahay' oo iska indho tiraysaa culeyska hal dhinac ah ee ay ku sifeyneyso 어쩌겠어.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wax ha odhan, sababtoo ah way aqbashay.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Isku mid ka dhigidda aqbalaadda iyo heshiis.
x-k-k10-04.s.s1.reflect: Isla erayada, 네 iyo 괜찮아, mar kasta miisaan kala duwan bay lahaayeen. Calaamadaha hakadka sida 아… iyo hadallada sida 어쩌겠어 waxay sidaan waxa erayada edebta ahi aysan sheegin.
x-k-k10-04.s.s2.prompt: Ingiriis ama Kuuriyaan ahaan, sharax sida akhrintaadu u beddeshay laga bilaabo qaybtii ugu horreysay ilaa tii ugu dambeysay. Soo xig ugu yaraan laba weedh Kuuriyaan ah oo ku dhaqaajiyay.

x-k-k10-06.title: Hadalka isku-dhaca weedhdiisa
x-k-k10-06.goal: Hel weedhda halka hadal-gaabsade uu la isku dhaco inta kale ee weedhda, dooro dayactir, ka dibna adigu dayactir weedh labaad oo isku dhacaysa.
x-k-k10-06.material: Barte ayaa qoray afar weedhood oo loogu talagalay blog fasal wuxuuna weedh kasta ku isticmaalay hadal-gaabsade. (Hadal-gaabsadayaasha: 발등에 불이 떨어지다 = in lagu hor yimaado dhibaato degdeg ah; 누워서 떡 먹기 = aad u fudud; 발이 넓다 = in dad badan la yaqaan; 소문난 잔치에 먹을 것 없다 = hype ka badan xaqiiqada.)
x-k-k10-06.thinking.0: Ogaanshaha khilaaf u dhexeeya hadal-gaabsade iyo macnaha hareeraha
x-k-k10-06.thinking.2: Ka dhigidda hadal-gaabsade iyo macnaha hareeraha inay is waafaqaan
x-k-k10-06.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan hadal-gaabsadayaasha 발등에 불이 떨어지다, 누워서 떡 먹기, 발이 넓다 sida erayo ereyga
x-k-k10-06.prereq.1: Wuu akhriyi karaa qoraallo gaaban oo barte
x-k-k10-06.s.s1.prompt: Hal weedh ayaa isticmaasha hadal-gaabsade sida ka soo horjeedda inta kale ee weedhda. Xariiqdee?
x-k-k10-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ku beddel hadal-gaabsade xariiq kasta macnihiisa, ka dibna mar kale akhri.
x-k-k10-06.s.s1.hint.1: Raadi natiijo aan ka imaanayn hadal-gaabsadaha.
x-k-k10-06.s.s1.explain: Xariiqda 3 ayaa ah dhibaatada. 발이 넓다 macnaheedu waa in dad badan la yaqaan, laakiin inta kale waxay tiraahdaa hoggaamiyaha kooxda guriga ayaa jooga, kulan-na ma aado. Saddexda hadal-gaabsade ee kale waxay ku habboon yihiin macnahooda hareeraha.
x-k-k10-06.s.s2.prompt: Dayactirkee ee xariiqda 3 ayaa ilaaliya hadal-gaabsadaha oo ka dhigaya weedhda mid macquul ah?
x-k-k10-06.s.s2.hint.0: Weydii doorashooyinkee ayaa wali macno samaynaya haddii 발이 넓다 macnaheedu yahay 'wuxuu yaqaan dad badan'.
x-k-k10-06.s.s2.hint.1: Meel dhig doorashooyinka ku sii jira macnaha dhabta ah ee cagaha.
x-k-k10-06.s.s2.r.a: Akhrinta hadal-gaabsadaha si ereyada ah sida cagaha ballaaran.
x-k-k10-06.s.s2.r.b: Ilaalinta hadal-gaabsadaha oo siinta natiijo ku habboon 'wuxuu yaqaan dad badan'.
x-k-k10-06.s.s2.r.c: Wuxuu ilaaliyaa hadal-gaabsadaha, laakiin natiijadu wali ma imaanayso: in dad badan la yaqaan ma aha sabab looga fogaado dadka.
x-k-k10-06.s.s2.r.d: Akhrinta hadal-gaabsadaha si ereyada ah sida cagaha ballaaran iyo iibsashada kabaha.
x-k-k10-06.s.s2.explain: Dayactir wanaagsan wuxuu ilaaliyaa 발이 넓다 sida 'wuxuu yaqaan dad badan' wuxuuna ku daraa natiijo, sida aqoonta dad kala duwan waaxyaha. Akhrinta ereyada (a, d) waxay isticmaalaan erayada, ma aha hadal-gaabsadaha, c-na wuxuu hayaa khilaafka.
x-k-k10-06.s.s3.prompt: Barte kale ayaa qoray: "그 식당은 소문난 잔치에 먹을 것 없다더니 음식이 정말 맛있고 줄도 길어서 매일 가요." Hadal-gaabsadaha wuxuu la isku dhacaa inta kale. Dib u qor HAL weedh Kuuriyaan ah si hadal-gaabsadaha (ama hadal kale) iyo inta kale ay isu waafaqaan, adigoo beddelaya wax yar sida ugu macquulsan.
x-k-k10-06.s.s3.hint.0: Go'aami waxa hadal-gaabsadaha ka sheegayo makhaayadda, ka dibna hubi haddii inta kale ee weedhdu sheegayso isla wax.
x-k-k10-06.s.s3.hint.1: Waad beddeli kartaa inta kale ee weedhda si ay ula jaanqaaddo hadal-gaabsadaha, ama waad beddeli kartaa bilowga si uu ula jaanqaado inta kale.
x-k-k10-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Haddii aan hayo hadal-gaabsadaha, inta kale ee weedhdayda ma sheegtaa isla wax hadal-gaabsadaha sheegayo?
x-k-k10-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma beddelay waxa loo baahnaa oo keliya?

x-k-k10-07.title: La dooday, laakiin ma aha 'inta badan'
x-k-k10-07.goal: Hel ciwaanka xad-dhaafka ah ee natiijooyinka sahanka la bixiyay, ka dibna dhis saddex natiijo sahan oo 'ka badan ayaa ka soo horjeeda marka loo eego kuwa taageeray' ay run tahay laakiin 'inta badan ayaa ka soo horjeeda' aysan run ahayn.

x-k-k10-07.s.s1.prompt: Sahanku wuxuu helay 찬성 60, 반대 90, 모름 50. Ciwaankee ayaa sheegaya wax ka badan waxa tirooyinkan taageeraan?

x-k-k10-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka hubi mid kasta 60, 90 iyo 50 ka mid ah 200.
x-k-k10-07.s.s1.r.b: Isbarbardhigga labada jawaab oo keliya iyo ka tagidda mid saddexaad.
x-k-k10-07.s.s1.r.c: U qaadashada 'inta badan' sida 'ka badan koox kasta oo kale' iyo seegista in 90 ka mid ah 200 ay ka yartahay badh.
x-k-k10-07.s.s1.r.d: U beddelidda tirooyinka saamiyo koox oo dhan (90, 60, 50 ka mid ah 200).
x-k-k10-07.s.s1.explain: 과반 macnaheedu waa wax ka badan badh. Badhka 200 waa 100, 90-na way ka yar tahay, sidaas darteed ciwaanka leh 과반 wuxuu sheegayaa wax ka badan. Kuwa kale si sax ah ayay u soo sheegaan tirooyinka.
x-k-k10-07.s.s2.prompt: Gali saddex natiijo sahan oo kala duwan (200 qof wadar ahaan) halka ka soo horjeedku yahay kooxda ugu weyn (ka badan 찬성 iyo ka badan 모름), laakiin aan ka badnayn 100, leh ugu yaraan 20 taageeray iyo ugu yaraan 20 ka jawaabay 모름.
x-k-k10-07.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dooro tirada ka soo horjeeda; ka dhig 100 ama ka yar.
x-k-k10-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ka dibna dooro tirooyin ka yar oo ah kuwa taageeray iyo 모름 si saddexduba isu ururiyaan 200.

x-k-k10-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Saddexda tiro waa inay isu ururiyaan 200.
x-k-k10-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Ka badan ayaa ka soo horjeeda marka loo eego kuwa taageeray.
x-k-k10-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Ka soo horjeeddu waa inuu ka weyn yahay taageerada.

x-k-k10-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Ingiriis ama Kuuriyaan ahaan, sharax sababta 'ka soo horjeeddu waa kooxda ugu weyn' u oggolaanayn ciwaanka '과반 반대', iyo doorka labada koox ee kale.

x-k-k10-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegay cidda aan lagu tirin ka soo horjeedayaasha?

x-k-k10-07.s.s2.because.model.2: Kooxda ugu weyn waa badh ka yar oo keliya; 모름 iyo 찬성 isku darkooda waxay noqon karaan sida 반대 ama ka weyn.
